notes:
Manuscript page 110 (scan 111), undated on this leaf; no separate verbal title is present. It is a mathematical manuscript sheet in the same principal hand throughout, with diagonal marginal additions, three boxed groups, an enclosed inserted R label with a descending attachment stem and several heavily revised expressions. Paper edges, fold, stains and faint background texture are not treated as ink.

The original and both supplied overlapping full-resolution halves were personally viewed once each, followed by thirteen saved crops, one for each genuinely open location. A prior attempted combined witness/image output was discarded by the context limit and was not a personal image view; only the later successful image emission is counted. No OCR, external research or compilation was used. Each crop filename and its actual original-pixel box is recorded.

The doubled V forms in R_i and Q_i are genuinely more complex than the plain V elsewhere. Neither the same-page comparison nor the main-reader comparison secures intentional blackboard V versus a rewritten ordinary V, so that alphabet distinction remains in place as a doubt. The separate Q-definition J underline, underlined Omegas and the selected underlined O glyphs are transcribed occurrence by occurrence, without normalizing other instances. The small O subscript in the R_i generator favors k but remains k|Sigma.

The pairing margin is substantially readable: a fixed circular order (i,j,k), equality of the three wedge products, y modulo F, and the matrix minors. The raised digit after les is represented as an insertion with 3|2 uncertainty. Direct determinant expansion gives three equal coefficients ad-bc and there are three 2-by-2 minors, but this mathematical context is not allowed to erase the remaining digit ambiguity. The overwritten sign before 2 in the cotangent display likewise remains uncertain despite the expected degree -2.

The author writes attention signes! twice, once after the exterior-product discussion and once under the R-evaluation box, and writes NB above the inverse-orientation identity. These are the author’s actual cautions, not evidence that every statement on the page was proved. The real checks performed in this reading are listed separately and confined to the pairing, elementary vector identities and local rank-two line-bundle calculation.

The Q margin says O(omega), indexés, and plain Q_i,Q_i prime, with no detached tildes. The later donc display unmistakably uses tildes. The right margin reaches the cut paper edge before any outer closing parenthesis; none is supplied. The insertion above classe de has a curved attachment stroke leading into a cancellation, represented in TikZ. The main-line and lower cancelled phi layers in the Q box are stacked beneath the clean upper replacement phi_{omega i,i}; their obscured original indices remain tentative.

The clean Q_i^omega=phi_{omega i,i}(Q_i) and the NB sign and doubling identities agree in V/Q_i: writing j=omega i, k=omega^2 i gives e_j+e_k=2e_i. The separately written older tilde-Q formula yields twice that generator. The uncertain inserted equality, if its tentative e_{omega^2 i}-e_{omega i} reading is correct, has the same factor-two tension. These are retained as revision tensions on the page, not silently harmonized.

The short cancelled cluster before racine and the small cancelled cluster after on prendra are tentatively zeta-like symbols. The former does not establish the complete word racine supplied by C. Their readings remain marked doubtful. The final exponential has no visible closing parenthesis or full stop. The P heading explicitly has underlined omega_J in its first domain and plain omega in its last one; the latter is kept as written.

C/H editorial macros, explanatory notes and page-marker syntax were not counted as source text. marked_in_H is true only for an actual uncertain/ill wrapper in the relevant H reading, not merely because an H editorial note mentions doubt. Confidence changes alone are excluded from changes; the thirteen supplied marks are decided separately.

Main-reader local adjudications after the first return: main_D25 shows that the contour around tilde R_i is open at the lower left and continues into a short downward insertion stem beside the baseline R_i. The TikZ geometry is corrected accordingly (D63). The main reader’s main_D32_33 crop shows that the supposed underline beneath O in the global-sections Gamma display is actually the top arm of the subscript Sigma: that underline and the former D33 row are removed. The independent underline in the later phi-section display (D34), and the earlier exterior-product O underline, remain. These edits use the main reader’s inspection; reader_b did not reread or recrop either place, and the main crop is therefore not added to reader_b’s personal views list.

check_events.statement: For x,y in ker(sum: O^3 -> O), x wedge y wedge e_i = x wedge y wedge e_j = x wedge y wedge e_k, and the form factors through y mod F when x lies in F.
check_events.outcome: Executed an exact integer determinant coefficient calculation with x=a(1,0,-1)+b(0,1,-1), y=c(1,0,-1)+d(0,1,-1). For each e_l the coefficients of ac,ad,bc,bd were (0,1,-1,0), giving ad-bc. Alternation makes the form vanish when y lies in the same line F as x. This checks the displayed pairing identity; it does not settle the inserted handwritten digit.

check_events.statement: phi_ij+phi_jk+phi_ki=0; phi_jk(R_i)=0, phi_jk(R_k)=tilde R_k and phi_jk(R_j)=-tilde R_j under the stated class definitions.
check_events.place: section definitions and boxed R evaluations
check_events.outcome: Expanded phi_ab=e_b-e_a. The cyclic sum telescopes to zero (also returned (0,0,0) by the exact vector calculation). Since R_i is generated by e_k-e_j, that section vanishes in V/R_i. At R_k its class is the defining e_k-e_j class for tilde R_k; at R_j it is the negative of e_j-e_k defining tilde R_j. These are elementary quotient identities, with no independent geometric claim beyond the displayed definitions.

check_events.statement: For j=omega i, k=omega^2 i and Q_i generated by -2e_i+e_j+e_k, the live Q_i^omega=phi_{omega i,i}(Q_i) satisfies Q_i^{omega^{-1}}=-Q_i^omega and phi_{omega i,omega^2i}(Q_i)=2Q_i^omega.
check_events.place: clean replacement in Q box and NB margin
check_events.outcome: Executed exact vector arithmetic: (e_k-e_j)-2(e_i-e_j)=(-2,1,1), the Q_i generator, and (e_i-e_k)+(e_i-e_j)=(2,-1,-1), its negative. Thus both identities hold in V/Q_i. The tentative insertion e_i-e_j=e_k-e_j fails over Q: its difference is (1,0,-1), not a scalar multiple of (-2,1,1). That last test is conditional on the uncertain reading and is reported as a risk, not a definitive refutation of unreadable ink.

check_events.statement: From the rank-two exact sequence 0 -> F -> V_Sigma -> L=O(1) -> 0 and det V=O(omega), one obtains F(1)=O(omega), Omega^1=F(-1)=O(-2)(omega), and the dual O(2)(omega).
check_events.place: upper exact sequence, determinant and differential displays
check_events.outcome: Checked locally: determinants give F tensor L = det V; first-order deformations of a line give tangent Hom(F,L), hence cotangent Hom(L,F)=F tensor L^{-1}. Substitution yields O(-2) tensor det V. The orientation sign line is self-dual, so the dual is O(2) with the same orientation twist. This verifies the indicated local line-bundle calculation under the definitions displayed on the sheet; it does not authorize changing the overwritten -2 or unmarked alphabets.

check_events.statement: For a three-element ordered J and V=ker(sum: k^J -> k), x,y in V satisfy x wedge y wedge e_i = x wedge y wedge e_j = x wedge y wedge e_k; the 3-by-2 matrix (x,y) has three 2-by-2 minors.
check_events.place: marginal pairing note, raised digit before mineurs
check_events.outcome: Checked directly: each e_i-e_j lies in the rank-two space V, so x wedge y wedge (e_i-e_j)=0. The three row-pairs are {i,j},{j,k},{k,i}; their determinants, with the cyclic orientation, agree. This supports 3 as context but does not settle the ink; the raised digit remains unsure{3|2}.
